summary: Dublin, Ireland, professional physicist, numerical astrophysicist, strong interest in programming languages (Haskell, Mathematica, Sage), advocate for data protection rights, fluent in Irish, interest in Celtic culture and politics, critical of capitalism, engaged in discussions about social justice and immigration, frequent references to academic and scientific literature, active in online communities focused on technology and programming, critical of mainstream media, interest in open-source software and ethical technology practices.
